_comment: Curated subset of addresses for Pokemon Feuerrote (German Fire Red), sourced from Ironmon-Tracker's Pokemon Feuerrote.json (MIT licensed). EWRAM (02xxxxxx) addresses are identical across all language versions of a game per GameSettings.lua's documented invariant, so these are used directly without RAM-search discovery. The ROM (08xxxxxx) addresses under RomDataTables carry NO such guarantee -- ROM layout is language-specific, and these values are correct only for this German revision, which is why PokemonReader.configureRomTables() fingerprints them at startup before trusting them. RomHeader values are used as a startup sanity check to confirm the loaded ROM matches this table.
